facts.business: Sukhjit Starch and Chemicals Limited is one of India's oldest and leading manufacturers of starch and starch derivatives, offering products such as Native Starch, Dextrines, Pre-gel Starch, liquid glucose, Malto-dextrin Powder, Dextrose Monohydrate, Sorbitol, Dextrose Anhydrous and allied by-products.

auditor.name: Y K Sud & Co., Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Raw material price volatility, particularly maize
Competing uses of maize such as biofuel/ethanol production
Inflationary pressures and energy price volatility
facts.related_party_note: Unsecured Loans as on 31.03.2026 include Rs 4.45 Crores (P.Y. Rs 2.92 Crores) received from directors, made out of their own funds. Transactions with subsidiary companies mainly include supply of key infrastructural facilities and utilities by Sukhjit Mega Food Park and Infra Ltd.
